Velo 0.46: you can join without an invite.

• In the Velo from the website or the store, “Create an account” works without an invite: a quick check that you are not a robot, then you choose your user name and password.
• When you block someone on the public server, you can also report them to Velo. The report does not say who sent it.
• Invite a friend: whoever joins with your invite is straight away among your contacts, and you among theirs.
• Fixed in the public Velo: a contact typed by name was refused as being on another server.
• Fixed: “Live location” from the paper clip now asks for how long to share it and starts (before, nothing happened).
Remove %1$s? As soon as their phone connects, Velo deletes chats, photos, files and keys from it, then the account is deleted from the server. Until then the account stays active.
Wipe the phone of %1$s? As soon as it connects, Velo deletes chats, photos, files and keys from it. The account stays: they can come back with a new phone and the invite.
